events.title: Small tweaks and bug fix
events.summary: -Add some new animations and illustrations.-Removed a strange bug I accidentally created recently that causes UI to stack.-Minor adjustment to the hammer and pickaxe accuracy booster in their abilities.-Tutorial mode now locks some buttons temporarily to prevent players from getting lost.-Some textual hint and tips will appear for some weapons when you look up their description-fix bug where screen resolution wont saved-disabled action buttons now flashes white for more clarity

events.title: Adjustments on the Combat Ui and In game Manual
events.summary: Adjusted colors on the combat UI to make it easier to look.Simplified the in game manual.

events.title: Major Game Update
events.summary: -Adjust item stats and cost, and enemy stats encourage more strategical variety-Allies now have health and lose 1 point of health instead of dying instantly when used in fights-Some Ui changes for more clarity-Some weapons have their abilities changed-Fixed more typos-In game manual has been changed(still working on improvements)-Some new battle animations and effects-Fix bug with the item "Nasty Flesh" that wont consume

events.title: Minor Updates
events.summary: -Adjust UI color. -Fix some minor bugs.-Add some new battle animation.

events.title: Playtest now close but Demo is now open
events.summary: Thank you to all that has given me feedback during the play test. To prevent redundancy of having to upload 2 versions of my game, I decide to close the play test and make current updates on the demo build.

events.title: Small Patches
events.summary: Patch a bug where you can still click on the combat buttons while the turn is running.Ally Attack description should now be visible.Patch some knife using related Events.

events.title: Updated the Combat System and the in game Store.
events.summary: I finally finished overhauling the combat system so now its a 2 move per turn instead of one. The store also now lists all the items in its inventory and no longer has any oxygen requirement.I also adjusted the numbers of some of the negative outcomes of events, hunt down and fix more grammar issues, fix some bugs, and added some new items. Hopefully now the combat feels more fun and runs more smoothly.

events.title: Planned overhall on the combat system.
events.summary: i got a good number of feedback on the game's current combat mechanics and decide it needs an overhaul. So, instead of a one move per turn combat system, You can use up to two moves instead. The tactical ability(the row next to the shield symbol) will always move first. Using an item will take up a slot, and the 2 abilities within the black box over the 2 will take up 2 slots so you are only able to use one move if you choose those abilities.I am still working on this update, it has not been add
